svg.title: Where the user comes from, and where Windows joins: three host options
svg.desc: Three columns for Entra joined, AD DS joined and Domain Services joined session hosts. Entra joined: cloud-only or synchronized users, and Windows joins Microsoft Entra ID, with no AD domain join required. AD DS joined: AD DS users synchronized to Microsoft Entra ID, and Windows joins your AD DS domain; hybrid join adds an Entra device identity. Domain Services joined: Entra users synchronized to the managed domain, and Windows joins the managed domain, whose domain controllers Microsoft manages. A banner says Microsoft Entra ID authenticates access to the Azure Virtual Desktop service in every path.
svg.text: Where the user comes from, and where Windows joins: three host options
Microsoft Entra ID authenticates access to the Azure Virtual Desktop service in every path
Hybrid join adds an Entra device identity
Hybrid join = AD DS joined and also registered with Entra ID
A synchronized user can use an Entra joined host. That does not make the host hybrid joined.
